inputs.rule: cold part read: 2 GetObject per stream (marks blob and .bin range), no statistics GET (inline); warm part read: 1 GetObject per stream

source_refs.claim: .bin, marks and primary.idx stay blobs; every other part file up to 1 MiB (statistics.packed, data.cmrk4, checksums.txt) is inline in the manifest
an inline file is served from the manifest bytes and sends no request
part views are retained after the load: a read resolves blob keys without a manifest GET
a part file read resolves to its blob object through the part view
the marks of each stream are loaded once into the mark cache, keyed by part path
a stream read is one .bin range at these sizes
